purpose: Test the only untried midpoint between V170 quota zero and V171 quota two: deterministically admit one heavy incomplete-parent terminal player per active window, seeking to relieve V170 starvation without V171 two-player capacity diversion.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.supported: Quota two over-corrects V170 starvation: it deactivates the guard quickly but diverts enough capacity to worsen throughput on twelve seeds and QPR on ten. A single deterministic admission is the unique monotone midpoint and should provide progress to one terminal chain while reserving capacity for the existing runnable set.

selected_seed_coverage.E01: large V171 QPR regression with moderate activation
selected_seed_coverage.E02: V171 QPR gain but throughput regression with high activation
selected_seed_coverage.E15: large throughput regression despite few active windows
selected_seed_coverage.E20: QPR improvement but large throughput regression

single_mechanism_change_from_v171.activation_rule: unchanged: active exactly when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than two
single_mechanism_change_from_v171.inactive_rule: unchanged exact V159 terminal admission for zero, one or two heavy players
single_mechanism_change_from_v171.active_rule: admit at most one heavy incomplete-parent terminal player selected by ascending request_id then function_id; reject every remaining heavy terminal player; all light terminal and parents-completed behavior remains unchanged
unchanged: SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
V159 nonterminal short-work admission at remaining work at most 5.5 and queue density strictly below 8
Hiku2/OCS queue-density-8 placement router and all player scores
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

checks: exact six-seed product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
guard active exactly when heavy terminal count is strictly greater than two
active heavy quota is exactly one, selected by ascending request_id then function_id, and exercised
at most one heavy terminal player is admitted in every active window and all excess heavy players are rejected
inactive windows retain exact V170/V159 admission and parents-completed players bypass the guard
short-work and placement-router boundaries remain unchanged

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V170 E01, E02, E13, E15, E16 and E20 with V172 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_six_seed_paired_gate: at least three selected seeds beat paired Orion
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_six_seed_paired_gate: at least one selected seed beats paired OCS
diagnostic_selection_rule.full_throughput_gate: mean strictly greater than Orion 1.4741 and at least 12 of 20 wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.full_qpr_gate: both QPR means strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697, at least 12 of 20 wins, and all finite
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all six valid V172 diagnostics, retire V172 and do not run its other fourteen seeds
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-fourteen V172 plan reusing these six rows
